title: pifira: Pressure-based inverse fire analysis with evidence-gated LH2 utilities
description:
A data-agnostic Python toolkit for pressure-based inverse fire heat analysis of pressurized tanks, supplemented by state-point and pathwise liquid-hydrogen ortho-para credit screens, published natural-conversion kinetics, and fixed-nozzle comparators.

No experimental data, source documents, digitized traces, or derived validation tables are distributed. The repository records only provenance and acquisition links for third-party validation sources.
